threat_model.threat_source: The AI (the system that 'takes off rapidly,' 'rapidly develops faster hardware,' and 'rapidly develops smarter AI software' in the three hard takeoff scenarios)
threat_model.objective_or_harmful_outcome: No intention is stated. Harmful outcome: hard takeoff limits fail — 'a hard takeoff proceeds rapidly, with no opportunity for human intervention' (the three scenarios are described as 'failures of hard takeoff limits')
threat_model.capability: The AI 'takes off rapidly' (hardware quantity scenario), 'rapidly develops faster hardware' (hardware quality scenario), and 'rapidly develops smarter AI software' (software quality scenario)
threat_model.constraints_or_enabling_conditions: The hard takeoff 'proceeds rapidly, with no opportunity for human intervention'; in the hardware quantity scenario, the AI takes off rapidly 'due to an abundance of available hardware' (hardware overhang)
threat_model.target_or_asset_at_risk: Hard takeoff limits (which 'fail'); the opportunity for human intervention (absent — 'no opportunity for human intervention')

evidence.threat_source: (1) hardware quantity, in which the AI takes off rapidly due to an abundance of available hardware (also known as hardware overhang; see Sotala and Yampolskiy 2015); (2) hardware quality, in which the AI rapidly develops faster hardware (also known as speed explosion; see Sotala and Yampolskiy 2015); and (3) software quality, in which the AI rapidly develops smarter AI software (also known as intelligence explosion; see Sotala and Yampolskiy 2015)
evidence.objective_or_harmful_outcome: Hard takeoff limits fail. A hard takeoff proceeds rapidly, with no opportunity for human intervention. ... Figure 3 models three hard takeoff scenarios (i.e., failures of hard takeoff limits)
evidence.capability: the AI takes off rapidly due to an abundance of available hardware ... the AI rapidly develops faster hardware ... the AI rapidly develops smarter AI software
evidence.constraints_or_enabling_conditions: A hard takeoff proceeds rapidly, with no opportunity for human intervention. ... due to an abundance of available hardware
evidence.target_or_asset_at_risk: Hard takeoff limits fail. ... with no opportunity for human intervention
